description: This file implements a handler for querying call log data on Android devices. It defines data classes for call log records and search requests, performs permission checks, constructs database queries to retrieve call logs with filtering options, and formats the results into JSON for external use. It encapsulates core logic for accessing call logs within the app, including permission validation and JSON serialization.

classes.name: CallLogRecord
classes.description: Data class representing an individual call log record, including number, cached contact name, call date, duration, and call type.

classes.name: CallLogSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating search parameters for filtering call logs, such as limit, offset, contact name, number, date range, duration, and call type.

classes.name: CallLogDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for permission checking and searching call logs.

classes.name: SystemCallLogDataSource
classes.description: Concrete implementation of CallLogDataSource that accesses Android's CallLog content provider.

classes.name: CallLogHandler
classes.description: Main class providing functionality for handling call log search requests, permission validation, and JSON serialization of results.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to read call logs.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a database query to retrieve call logs based on supplied filters, returning a list of CallLogRecord objects.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch
methods.description: Processes a search request in JSON format, validates permissions, performs the search, and returns results in JSON format.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string to construct a CallLogSearchRequest object with filtering parameters.

methods.name: callLogJson
methods.description: Converts a CallLogRecord object into a JSON object for serialization.
